purpose: The card token vault stores primary account numbers securely and allows payment services to tokenize and detokenize card numbers.

components.name: tokenization-service
components.evidence: tokenization-service is the service that offers the two operations, tokenize and detokenize.

components.name: vault-db
components.evidence: vault-db (PostgreSQL) holds the card records and the mapping between tokens and card numbers.

components.name: Vault and KMS
components.evidence: Vault and KMS supply the data encryption keys that tokenization-service requests.

components.name: vault private subnet
components.evidence: The vault private subnet is the network segment in which all components run.

flows.evidence: tokenization-service creates a random token, stores the encrypted number with the token in vault-db and returns the token.
Vault and KMS supply the data encryption keys that tokenization-service requests.
A payment service sends a card number.
A payment service sends a token and a purpose code.
